alignments.note: Noun rendered by the bare English noun.
Article on the wine; the ASV writes no *the* for the phrase (rule 29).
Predicate of a verbless clause: the construction-supplied copula joins it under rule 20, and the indefinite article is the nominal's own under rule 15.
Rule 31 subtraction: *drink* alone is any drink, so the head goes on *strong*, which carries the intoxicating lexeme. Heading on *drink* as a class noun was the competing reading.
Second colon's predicate; the ASV writes no copula here, and the indefinite article joins the nominal under rule 15.
Waw taking the *And* written for it (rule 14).
Quantifying construct noun rendered by the substantival *whosoever*.
Participle keeping its own lexical verb; the substantival pronoun is carried by the quantifier.
Preposition with its own suffix fused in the single pronominal adverb *thereby*, headed on the preposition (rules 22, 30).
Finite verb with its copula/auxiliary, discontinuous around the negative under rule 25.

review_notes: The marginal *Or, reeleth* was read and set aside under rule 38; the printed *erreth* governs.
The head of *strong drink* is the one materially contestable choice; noted in the unit.
